camel_example: aliyun ossutil api restore-object --bucket examplebucket --key exampledir/exampleobject/txt --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Restores an Archive or Cold Archive object
description_zh: 解冻归档类型（Archive）或冷归档（Cold Archive）的文件（Object）
name: RestoreObject

parameters.help_en: The full path of the object
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The version ID of the object to restore
parameters.name: version_id

fields.help_en: The number of days for which the object remains in the restored state. Valid values: 1 to 7
fields.help_zh: 解冻的天数。取值范围为1~7天
fields.name: days

fields.help_en:
The restore priority. Valid values:
Expedited: the restore is completed within 1 hour.
Standard: the restore is completed within 2 to 5 hours.
Bulk: the restore is completed within 5 to 12 hours
fields.help_zh:
解冻优先级。取值范围如下：
高优先级（Expedited）：表示1小时内完成解冻。
标准（Standard）：表示2~5小时内完成解冻。
批量（Bulk）：表示5~12小时内完成解冻
fields.name: tier

fields.help_en: The container for the restore priority. This parameter takes effect only when you restore Cold Archive objects. If you do not specify the JobParameters node, the restore priority defaults to Standard
fields.help_zh:
解冻优先级的容器。只有解冻冷归档类型的Object时才生效。
如果不传入JobParameters节点，则解冻优先级默认为Standard
fields.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The container for the restore request information
parameters.name: restore_request

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body that contains the restore request information
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 保存解冻请求信息的请求体
v1_body_parameters.name: body
